notes.title: Exciting News
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
Thank you for playing the Workshop Wonders.

Dear players,

Thanks to your support, we have brought our game to a great position. Now, we are working on new features to provide you with a more comprehensive and exciting experience. Our goal is to bring the game to its full release by adding all the necessary improvements.

The upcoming major update will include workshop systems, new animations, a dynamic day-night cycle, a thief mechanic, and various performance optimizations. We appreciate your patience and understanding, and we truly value your support.

Enjoy the game!
Superwolf Development Team

notes.title: Major Update Incoming!
notes.content:
Dear Workshop Wonders Players,

We’re excited to share some news about the major update we’ve been working on, inspired by your valuable feedback! This update will introduce significant changes to the game mechanics.

As a small game development team, things can get a bit complex at times, but our commitment to delivering the best experience for you remains unwavering. We plan to roll out this update by next weekend. Here’s what you can expect in the new update:

 License-Based Product Unlocks: Products will now be unlocked through licenses instead of level requirements.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45184169/ab4cd3cc63fe4cf4bbba652a3e7fb348fae8e40b.png
 Level Requirements Removed: Shelves, registers, trash bins, and the skill system will no longer have level restrictions.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45184169/ba8faa153ce4985ec8817faee4d0d8e2c5181cd7.png
 Snow-Free Map: The map will be cleared of snow for a cleaner and more streamlined visual experience.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45184169/d2716d036abdd0f0e2ee49656ad2376e7f11b6df.png
 Detailed Product Management Screen: A new and improved product management screen will allow you to see how many of each item are on your store and warehouse shelves, as well as in your storage boxes.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45184169/5466beae8f83c9e2ed1c2e77b1dcc650fe0f4b6f.png

Alongside this update, we are not only introducing new features but also addressing critical bug fixes and implementing performance optimizations. Our goal is to make the overall game experience smoother and more enjoyable.

Thank you so much for your patience, support, and passion for Workshop Wonders. It’s players like you who inspire us to keep improving every day.

With love,
The Workshop Wonders Team

notes.title: How to Access Old Versions of the Game?
notes.content:
You can now access older versions of the game as part of our beta participation program. If you're unable to play the current version, you can switch back to a previous version by following these steps:

 Steps to Access Old Versions:  

 Go to Your Library.
 Locate Workshop Wonders in the list of games and right-click on it.
 Open the Betas Tab.
 From the menu that appears, click on Properties, and then navigate to the Betas tab.
 In the dropdown menu under "Beta Participation," select the version of the game you'd like to play.

notes.title: Patch v0.1.0.1
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
Thank you for playing Workshop Wonders Demo.

The following innovations have been introduced in this update.

 Fixed the issue where the product box could not be created after the product was purchased in the shop.
 Increased stability in the grid system of shop shelves.
 Npc walking systems added.
 Automatic door animations have been activated.
 Added a button to the pause menu that resets the player's position.
 German language support has been added.
 Fixed bugs with tool selection in the Radial menu.
 Fixed localization bugs.
 Changed the background image of the game main menu.
 Fixed bugs in the information system that caused incorrect text to be displayed about which button to press.
 The issues in the tutorial system have been resolved. The tutorial system is now more stable and functioning correctly.
 The size of the images on the label cards on the shelves has been increased.
 The previous pricing system has been completely removed. From now on, price adjustments can be made by clicking on the item label. You can view recommended prices from the tablet.

If you encounter any issues or problems, please reach out to us through our Discord or Steam community. Your feedback is essential for us to address and resolve the issue as quickly as possible.
